title: Royal Bank of Canada to help attract investment for Sunshine Coast Airport
description: Mayor Mark Jamieson talks about the Sunshine Coast's achievements in the first year of the Regional Economic Development Strategy. Council has engaged the Royal Bank of Canada to help attract private investment for the Sunshine Coast Airport expansion.

asr.full_text: I'm here today to report on the progress of the Regional Economic Development Strategy and, might I say it, I'm delighted to be at the Sunshine Coast Private Hospital, Buddram, who yesterday were announced as one of the top 10 hospitals in the country, which is an outstanding achievement, outstanding for the Sunshine Coast Private Hospital but also for the region given the importance the health medical and well-being sector will have on our economic development strategy. I'm delighted to have the importance of the health, medical and well-being sector will have on our economic development strategy. I'm delighted to have a couple of the economic development futures with with me here today as we basically mark our card on the successes of activities we've achieved since we launched the strategy last year. I guess most importantly the progress that's being made on the airport. We've announced recently that the Royal Bank of Canada will become our commercial manager to assist us in attracting or developing the best model and attracting the necessary investment for that. The Principal Activity Center in Morritchie Door, our new CBD, the State Government has signed off on that Priority Development Area, which we'll see to progress very quickly and there's a lot of work being done in export markets and also in the development of our task forces to manage the seven high value industries we've targeted for the future. So all in all, I think the business community on the Sunshine Coast can be very pleased with the progress that's being made, But all citizens can be pleased with the progress because it's about economic viability, economic stability and their futures in terms of jobs and opportunity.
